## Purpose

What problem or decision does this change address? Link the owning issue or ADR
when one exists.

## Architectural scope

Which repository, component, interface, or organization boundary owns this
change? Note any cross-repository relationship affected.

## Implementation summary

Describe the important behavior and files changed. Include significant design
decisions that are not already captured in an ADR.

## Verification evidence

- Checks run and exact results:
- Checks skipped or unavailable, with reason:
- Evidence level established (source, deterministic, simulated, live, etc.):

## Security and privacy

Describe authority, credentials, network, dependency, supply-chain, personal
data, protected knowledge, or threat-model effects. Write `Not applicable` when
there is no effect.

## Memory and data migration

Describe schema, provenance, retention, deletion, migration, rollback, and
cross-project isolation effects. Write `Not applicable` when there is no effect.

## Compatibility and rollout

Describe backward compatibility, release/version impact, rollout, rollback,
and operational readback. Distinguish implementation from deployment.

## Documentation

List documentation, manifest, ADR, changelog, and release-note updates, or
explain why none are needed.

## Unresolved risks

List remaining gates, uncertainty, follow-up, and explicitly unverified
boundaries. Do not convert a skip into a pass.
